DropTable.role: One removal request in statement order
invariants: Absolute targets are unique under the fixed relation name comparison
DropTable.meaning: Remove the targets and owned objects, using the native missing-object and dependency rules. PostgreSQL restricts external dependencies by default or deletes them under cascade, and its outcome participates in the active transaction. Persistent MySQL DROP implicitly commits and always uses MySQL dependency behavior. The release distinguishes partial removal when a target is missing in MySQL 5.6 and 5.7 from atomic InnoDB DROP in 8.x and 9.x.
DropTable.sql: Emit DROP TABLE, the explicit absence policy, the ordered absolute names, and explicit PostgreSQL dependency policy.
